rationale: With only 26 minutes to close, this instrument has already gapped down 7.6% and is sitting at 8.2% of its daily range near the session low, with a 99.9 bps bid-ask spread making entry extremely costly. The last 5 candles show a clear downward drift from 14.21 to 14.00 with no stabilization signal, and the wide spread combined with thin liquidity (low candle volumes) creates excessive slippage risk on both entry and forced close. The risk/reward does not justify a position given the spread cost, proximity to the low without a clear reversal structure, and the mandatory market-close liquidation compressing the available holding window.
